name: working-on
description: Right-side pane: what this session is working on, each task labelled by TypeSafe Jev with a category and a suggested model; can route each prompt to a model

typesafeApiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafeApiKey.description: Lets Jev label each task with a category and a suggested model. Without it the pane shows the summary only.

routing.title: Model routing
routing.description: off: no routing. suggest: show Jev's model pick for each prompt in the status line. auto: switch the main conversation's model per prompt, within the guardrails.
